scope: current pure field-to-provider contract, no runtime/provider operations

tests.name: known protocol name binds only the immutable system name identity
a shared custom import reference produces the supplier parameter without a duplicate definition
required provider parameters need explicit configured sources
optional classification fields can be stricter for a required scene parameter
FOLLOWUP fields cannot be consumed as imported values
disabled or removed fields fail closed while the original configuration remains intact
a category change cannot silently reinterpret stable field references
two fields cannot write the same supplier parameter
reserved and malformed parameter keys never enter payload objects
field key aliases with conflicting values are rejected
enum values use explicit business option codes; unknown values are not guessed
legacy required professional parameters remain requirements, not new business fields
provider-owned Houpu template parameters retain their exact requirements
unknown provider template identities do not become empty field lists
mapping or current schema changes invalidate captured parameter fingerprints
reading parameter metadata never mutates business values, fields or scene snapshots
scene save collects the actual parameter text and checked control even without blur events
scene save cannot silently consume a changed shared field schema
clearing optional parameter controls removes the mapping instead of saving a blank parameter
